# OpenType BASE test font

`DejaVuSans-BASE.ttf` is a subset of `assets/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf`, containing
the characters A and B. Its synthetic horizontal BASE table supplies `romn`
at 0 and `hang` at 700 font units for the Latin script. The font uses 2048
units per em. The source font license is in `assets/fonts/DejaVu-LICENSE.txt`.
The fixture was generated with fontTools subset and feaLib.
